title: Schedule of Value Loadings on Lapsed Travel Credits — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A loading in dollars is added to the fee charged under Air Ticket Fare Brands according to the value at which the lapsed vouchers stand together, and it is added once for the booking. The value taken is the total of the amounts of the lapsed travel credit vouchers standing together on the booking.

| Value at which the lapsed vouchers stand together | What is added |
| --- | --- |
| At or above 2500.00 US dollars | The high-value loading of 60.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged, once for the booking |
| At or above 800.00 US dollars but below 2500.00 US dollars | The mid-value loading of 25.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged, once for the booking |
| Below 800.00 US dollars | Nothing is added to the fee charged for the value standing |

Each band is satisfied by the figure at the band itself. Vouchers standing together at 2500.00 US dollars are at the high-value band, and 60.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged; at 2499.99 US dollars they fall below it and into the mid-value band, and 25.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged. Vouchers standing together at 800.00 US dollars are at the mid-value band, and 25.00 US dollars is added to the fee charged; at 799.99 US dollars nothing is added to the fee charged for the value standing. The loading answers to the value at which the vouchers stand together on the booking, so it is added once for the booking however many vouchers make up that value.
